findings.evidence: 6 newly added sites cite 'docs/CONVENTIONS.md §도구 출력 계약' as the normative SSOT for the single-line-JSON output contract. docs/CONVENTIONS.md has no such section — its headings are 언어 규칙 / 네이밍 규칙 / 파일 구조 / 브랜치 전략 / 커밋 규칙 / 구현 규칙(Guards·디스패치 의무·@header 규칙·Citation Rules·State 관리·도구 우선 원칙·배포 경계·플랫폼 분기 격리) / 루트 해석. Repo-wide grep for '도구 출력 계약' returns only these 6 sites plus tasks/131-*/PLAN.md:50; 0 hits in docs/CONVENTIONS.md. The nearest real owner is opal/core/references/tools.md:124, scoped to state-tool only.
findings.impact: A normative contract claim rests on a dangling pointer. Downstream workers and checkers cannot open the cited section to verify the contract, and every consumer treating docs/CONVENTIONS.md as T0 SSOT inherits the drift. Same defect class that reverted this gate twice.

remediation.guidance: Owner decision required (this agent must not edit the standard doc). Either (a) add '### 도구 출력 계약' under docs/CONVENTIONS.md §구현 규칙 stating that every subcommand returns a single-line JSON plus an exit code, and settle its ownership boundary against opal/core/references/tools.md:124; or (b) repoint all 6 citations to an existing owner such as opal/tools/oppl-runtime-tool/README.md §종료 코드 or opal/core/references/tools.md.

findings.verification: grep -n '도구 출력 계약' docs/CONVENTIONS.md returns >=1 hit (option a), or the string 'docs/CONVENTIONS.md §도구 출력 계약' returns 0 hits across the 6 sites (option b).
